mentions.name: Yomu
mentions.description: This iOS app helps people read Japanese text with adjustable furigana. Furigana can be hidden for kanji up to the reader's level while remaining visible for harder kanji. It is offline-first, supports importing text from anywhere, camera OCR, and includes a fast dictionary.
mentions.problem: Full furigana makes learners rely on readings instead of actually reading kanji.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on Yomu, an iOS app for reading Japanese text with adjustable furigana.
